TS0240001.message: No artifact with id `{id}` is stored.
TS0240001.solution: List artifacts to find an existing id.

TS0240002.message: Deleting artifact `{id}` requires the content hash of the version you read.
TS0240002.solution: Read the artifact, then retry the delete with that content hash.

TS0240003.message: Artifact `{id}` changed after it was read.
TS0240003.solution: Read the current artifact, decide again against that version, then retry.

TS0240004.solution: Delete or rewrite those resources first, then delete `{id}`.

TS0240005.message: Pipeline `{id}` is {actual} and is headed for {desired}, so it cannot be deleted.
TS0240005.solution: Stop the pipeline, let it settle, then delete it.

TS0240006.message: Artifact `{id}` was removed, but this bookkeeping was left behind ({reason}): {residue}.
TS0240006.solution: The removal stands, so do not retry it. If the pipeline is running again, stop it first; then clear the listed records by hand.
